Coverage remains at Lebl Theorem 10.7.2 and Leibman Theorem 5.5.7; sources are [Massot §6.4](https://www.imo.universite-paris-saclay.fr/~patrick.massot/enseignement/poly_alg/cha-algebres.html), [Lebl §10.7](https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/sec_mvchangeofvars.html), and [Leibman §1.4/§5.5](https://people.math.osu.edu/leibman.1/analysis2/m-analysis.pdf).

The two upstream interfaces are handed to batch 9 in [the notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-10-batch-5.notes.md:68), not minted by batch 5. The local dependency changes are in [pages.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-10-batch-5.pages.json:141) and [proof-contracts.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-10-batch-5.proof-contracts.json:891).

Convention findings recorded include:

- Over a general commutative ring, invertibility corresponds to determinant being a unit, not merely nonzero; the new criterion is therefore stated over \(\mathbb R\).
- Jacobian matrix notation is kept distinct from the scalar determinant.
- Source “measure zero” language is normalized to Jordan null/content-zero.
- Compact-set diffeomorphisms require extensions to open neighborhoods.
- Absolute-Jacobian one-dimensional substitution is reconciled with the published oriented formula.
- Lebl Proposition 10.5.8’s insufficient boundedness hypothesis is strengthened to continuous extension to the compact closure.

No published dependency was found false.
